$Comment: Gunter bowling as an extra combat behaviour (2026-10-21). Plugged into AT_Gunter_Minion through Template_Predator's AdditionalCombatBehaviorMacroElement: the template picks one of its combat movements at random every 5 s (Random, ExecuteFor 5) by weight (strafe 10 for Gunter); this one has Weight 3 (~1 pick in 4-5) and only when the player is 3-6 blocks away and in sight. When picked: aim at the player, Root_AT_Gunter_Slide once, then wait out the 5 s (Timeout 4), so at most one slide per pick. Untested in game: no vanilla file uses this interface, built from the template's slot (Interfaces Null / CombatBehavior, parameters CombatBehaviorDistance and ChaseRelativeSpeed).

CombatBehaviorDistance.Description: Distance at which the NPC is doing combat behaviours (from the template)

ChaseRelativeSpeed.Description: Chase speed (from the template, unused here)

SlideWeight.Description: Weight of the slide among the combat movements (Gunter's strafe is 10)
